description:
## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **"Phases 2–7 — Surface cards": the kickoff, and the Phase 4 card**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: decision D10 (widget swaps) and D6 (dialogs and the signed-out cover).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx-phase-4` from `feat/astryx` (merge `main` into `feat/astryx` first).

Files you may change, and no others in `app/` or `components/`:
- `frontend/components/flow/Recorder.tsx`, `LevelMeter.tsx`, `LiveSheet.tsx`, `ReadyPanel.tsx`, `AudioPlayer.tsx` and their new `*.module.css`
- `frontend/app/globals.css`: move the `lyssna-*` animations out, add `--module-color-record`
- `frontend/tests/e2e/checks.ts`: the slider-track lookup only, with a new case in `harness.spec.ts`
Plus: `frontend/tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (remove ported files, never add), the unit tests the card names (selectors
and class assertions only), the ARIA snapshots of this phase's states, `frontend/kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` for a
design-system shortfall (then `npm run theme:build`).

## Out of scope
- `lib/recording-session.ts`, `lib/recording-store.ts`, `lib/microphone.ts`, `lib/live-transcriber.ts`, `lib/pcm.ts`, `components/flow/live-audio.ts`, `recording-hooks.ts`: recording behaviour is not touched.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Kickoff, before any code: run this phase's gate states and unit tests (they must pass), run the loop in "How to
   work" for each screen, and write this phase's task list in the form of Phase 1's tasks (files, mapping table,
   behaviour to keep with the test that proves it, coupled tests, snapshots). Post it as a comment on this bead and
   get it reviewed before porting.
2. Port screen by screen following the card (bespoke surfaces allowed a CSS Module: `LevelMeter`, the pulse and blink, the docked recording bar). One commit per screen.
3. For each "widget swap to try" in the card: apply the rule in "Widget swaps". Record which path was taken.
4. Run the phase exit: lint, unit tests, build, this phase's gate states in all 19 projects, `test:prod`, screenshots and the page-cost table. Do not run the whole gate: the lead runs it after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate states pass in all 19 projects: `recording`, `recording-paused`, `recording-details-open`, `stromma`, `ready`, `ready-delete-dialog`, `time-left-15`, `time-left-5`, `too-long-for-one-file`, `silent-microphone`, `disk-full`, `microphone-muted`, `signed-out-recording`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; the gate states listed above pass in all 19 projects (`npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"` per state, on this worktree's own ports); `npm run test:prod` passes. The whole gate runs once, by the lead, after the phases are merged.
- `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` passes.
- Every file in Scope is off `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`: no string-literal `className`, no old imports.
- ARIA snapshots changed only for this phase's states, after reading the diff.
- Everything listed under "Keep" in the card still works, proved by the tests the card names.
- Pausa and Stoppa ignore a second tap for 700 ms; the live region says each status once and never the timer.
- The recording's controls move into the sign-in dialog when the login ends.
- Pulse and blink stop under reduced motion.
- The pull request into `feat/astryx` lists theme corrections, changed test expectations and widget-swap outcomes,
  with screenshots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light and ultrawide-3440-light.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run lint && npm test
npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"          # each state of this phase
npm run build && npm run test:prod   # plus the states above, with A11Y_APP_PORT/A11Y_STUB_PORT set to this phase's own pair
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.

## Read first
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-astryx-port-plan.md`: "Global Constraints" and "How to work" (every time), then **"Phases 2–7 — Surface cards": the kickoff, and the Phase 5 card**.
- `docs/plans/2026-10-01-module-platform-design.md`: decision D10 (widget swaps) and D6 (dialogs and the signed-out cover).
- `AGENTS.md` in the repository root, once Phase 0.4 has created it.

## Scope
Branch `feat/astryx-phase-5` from `feat/astryx` (merge `main` into `feat/astryx` first).

Files you may change, and no others in `app/` or `components/`:
- `frontend/components/flow/SubmittingView.tsx`, `RunProgress.tsx`, `StepList.tsx`, `StepDetails.tsx`, `RunFailure.tsx`
Plus: `frontend/tests/legacy-ui-files.json` (remove ported files, never add), the unit tests the card names (selectors
and class assertions only), the ARIA snapshots of this phase's states, `frontend/kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` for a
design-system shortfall (then `npm run theme:build`).

## Out of scope
- `lib/submit-run.ts`, `lib/follow-run.ts`, `lib/run-progress.ts`: sending and polling are not touched.
- `backend/` and everything under `frontend/lib/` except the test files named in Scope.
- Screens and components that belong to another bead.
- Gate thresholds, gate states, axe exclusions, and the Astryx versions (exact pins).
- Ejecting ("swizzling") an Astryx component, authoring StyleX, adding Tailwind classes.
- Plan B (removing Next.js) and Plan C (the module kit).
- If something outside this scope looks wrong, write a comment on this bead (`br comments add`) and leave it alone.

## Steps
1. Kickoff, before any code: run this phase's gate states and unit tests (they must pass), run the loop in "How to
   work" for each screen, and write this phase's task list in the form of Phase 1's tasks (files, mapping table,
   behaviour to keep with the test that proves it, coupled tests, snapshots). Post it as a comment on this bead and
   get it reviewed before porting.
2. Port screen by screen following the card (`Banner`, `Collapsible`, `Skeleton`, `Spinner`, `AlertDialog`; `ProgressBar`/`Stepper` only under the swap rule). One commit per screen.
3. For each "widget swap to try" in the card: apply the rule in "Widget swaps". Record which path was taken.
4. Run the phase exit: lint, unit tests, build, this phase's gate states in all 19 projects, `test:prod`, screenshots and the page-cost table. Do not run the whole gate: the lead runs it after the merge.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Gate states pass in all 19 projects: `sending`, `run-progress`, `run-started`, `failure`.
- `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass; the gate states listed above pass in all 19 projects (`npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"` per state, on this worktree's own ports); `npm run test:prod` passes. The whole gate runs once, by the lead, after the phases are merged.
- `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` passes.
- Every file in Scope is off `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`: no string-literal `className`, no old imports.
- ARIA snapshots changed only for this phase's states, after reading the diff.
- Everything listed under "Keep" in the card still works, proved by the tests the card names.
- The sending view is a page with a heading that takes focus, a named progress bar and a spoken stage.
- Eneo's English words on the failure view keep `lang="en"`.
- `run-views.test.ts` asserts one `data-variant="primary"` action instead of `bg-primary`.
- The pull request into `feat/astryx` lists theme corrections, changed test expectations and widget-swap outcomes,
  with screenshots at phone-320-light, phone-390-dark, laptop-1440-light and ultrawide-3440-light.

## Verify
```bash
cd frontend
npm run lint && npm test
npm run test:a11y -- -g "<state>"          # each state of this phase
npm run build && npm run test:prod   # plus the states above, with A11Y_APP_PORT/A11Y_STUB_PORT set to this phase's own pair
```

## If blocked
Stop and comment on this bead instead of working around it when: a step's expected result does not appear after
one honest attempt to fix the cause; a stop condition in the plan ("Stop conditions") holds; or the task seems to
need a change outside Scope.

RunFailure / steps - F1 `failure: null`, `run.error` null: Banner fallbacks ("Körningen kunde inte slutföras") and no "Startad" without `created_at`: new assertions in the L144 test. - F2 cancelled: Banner `info`, exactly one `data-variant="primary"` ("Starta en ny körning"): extend run-views L337. - F3 refusal and error with identical text: shown once, no duplicate-key warning: new test (fixes L108). - F4 `detail` empty: no "Visa teknisk information": new assertion. Long unbroken `detail`/step label/run id at 320 px: manual (risk 8). - F5 retry pending: `Försök igen` has `aria-busy` and is disabled, enabled again after the promise settles: new mount test (replaces the old `disabled`+spinner). - S1 `steps: []`: `StepDetails` renders `""` (the early return); `note: null`: no note element; `version` absent: no version line: new assertions. - S2 open/close: label flips, `aria-expanded` toggles, default closed: the rewrite of L279. - Not guarded today and unreachable (runSteps maps to six states): an unknown `step.state` crashes `ICONS[...]` (StepList.tsx:28). Leave it. ## 7. Overlays this phase adds One: the cancel question (`AlertDialog`, a PAGE dialog, native modal). Required, none of it is in the card: - `tests/e2e/leaks.spec.ts`: add `"cancel question": { show: click "Avbryt körningen", shown: getByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Avbryta körningen?" }), hide: click "Kör vidare" }`. The harness hard-codes `open(page, "/dev/foundation")` (L78), so the entry needs a page: add an optional `go?: (page) => Promise` per overlay (default foundation) and use `run(page, "run-running")` here. P4, P6, P7 need the same field: land it once. - `tests/e2e/session-cover.spec.ts` (D6 item 3; a native modal inside the inert cover stays visible and focusable, design doc L52): case "the cancel question open when the login ends is covered with the page, and is back after the new login": `run(page,"run-running")`, open it, `endLogin(page)`, expect the alertdialog hidden and absent from `body.ariaSnapshot()` (no "Avbryta körningen"), 12 Tabs stay in the sign-in dialog, renew, expect it open again, Escape, expect "Avbryt körningen" focused. Mechanism (Dialog.tsx:505-545): setting `isOpen` false closes the dialog without calling `onOpenChange`, so `asking` survives. On reopen Dialog records `document.activeElement` as the trigger to restore, which may then be the body: if the last assertion fails, focus the trigger through a ref in `onOpenChange(false)`. - No menu, picker or bottom sheet is added. ## 8. Risks, ordered 1. Reduced motion (gate, 3 of 4 states). Astryx Spinner and the indeterminate ProgressBar loop forever and are only slowed under reduced motion (Spinner.tsx:340 `animationIterationCount: 'infinite'`, 3 s; ProgressBar.tsx:258). `a11y.spec` runs every state in the `reduced-motion` project and `endlessAnimations` (checks.ts:251-261) fails on any running infinite animation: `sending`, `run-started`, `run-progress`, also Phase 1's `page-loading`/`signin-loading`. A theme rule cannot reach it: `astryx theme targets Spinner` gives only the root `.astryx-spinner`, the animation runs on the inner ``. The old rule (`.animate-spin, .animate-pulse { animation: none }`, globals.css:236-241) targets Tailwind classes. Fix once in `app/globals.css`, inside that media block: `.astryx-spinner circle, .astryx-progress-bar-fill { animation: none; }` (Skeleton already stops itself). `globals.css` is outside this bead's Scope. 2. D6 cover (section 7): the cancel question escapes the signed-out cover unless it is closed while signed out. Needs `isOpen={asking && !signedOut}` and the cover test. Every phase with a page dialog (P4 delete question, P6, P7) needs the same 3 lines: one shared `useSignedOut()` exported by `AuthGate.tsx` (P1's file) would stop four copies. 3. Touch targets in the built theme. Collapsible's trigger has `paddingBlock: 0` and no min-height (Collapsible.tsx:62-83): one text line (19 px type, about 28 px) under `pointer: coarse`, the gate wants 44 (`touchTargets`, a11y.spec). Fails on phone projects for `failure` (Kontakta support) and, in Phase 6 states, `result-steps-open`. Add `'collapsible-trigger': {base: {minHeight: TOUCH}}` to the existing coarse rule in `kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` + `npm run theme:build` (in Scope). Record in the PR. 4. Heading focus ring. `usePhaseHeading` focuses the h1 on mount; the old `outline-none` hid the browser ring (usePhaseHeading.ts:5-9 says why). Astryx `Heading` has no such rule, so a deep link or keyboard visit frames the title. Theme correction: `heading: { base: { ':focus-visible': { outline: 'none' } } }` (the theme already uses pseudo-class keys). Shared with P4, P6, P7 headings: one owner for the theme file. 5. Banner tone. `status="error"` paints a filled header (L181's intent: "calm, not red" for `inputMustChange`). Check at phone-390-dark and laptop-1440-light; for `inputMustChange` use `status="warning"` if red reads as an accusation. Dark-mode label contrast is already handled by `--color-on-error`. 6. Cross-phase interfaces: `StateCard` must keep `({children, ...div props})` including `aria-busy` (RunProgress.tsx:127); `STATE_HEADING` is exported by `StateCard.tsx` and used by ReadyPanel.tsx:29,147 (P4): P3 must not delete it before P4 and P5 stop using it; `BackToFlows` prop vocabulary (RunProgress.tsx:155); `sending` and `run-started` reach their state through `chooseFile` (`input[type="file"]`, "Byt fil", "Skapa dokument"; screens.ts:152-163), which P3's UploadPanel/docked action may change. 7. Widget swap `Stepper`: do not try. Its `Step` label is "kept to a single line and ellipsized", its model is linear (`activeStep`; no failed/cancelled/not-run), and it advises against fewer than 3 steps. Review Focus 3 forbids clamped names. `ListItem` is out too: a string label is single-line truncated by default (Item.tsx:458-465; `labelLines` is not among ListItem's documented props). Evidence for the PR: "Stepper rejected: truncates labels, linear model". This saves a trial. 8. Long words. Astryx `Text`/`Heading` set no `overflow-wrap` (only when `maxLines` is set), so a long step name, run id or Eneo detail can overflow a 320 px card. The stub's data is short, so the gate would not catch it. A shared theme correction (`text`, `heading`, `code`: `overflowWrap: 'anywhere'`) is the single fix; the lead should decide it once for all phases. 9. Page weight: `/flows/flow-1` (budget 430 KB JS) gains Banner, Collapsible, ProgressBar, Spinner, Skeleton, AlertDialog. Measure with `node docs/plans/page-cost.cjs` before/after. ## 9. Split into independent chunks Chunk 0, once, before the fork (lead or one agent; shared files only; one commit, theme rebuilt in the same commit): the `globals.css` reduced-motion rule (risk 1); the theme rules for risk 3 and 4 (and 8 if decided) + `theme:build`; the `leaks.spec.ts` `go` field; the shared `useSignedOut()` or the agreement to inline AuthGate.tsx:80. Then, no file in common: - Agent 1: chunk A `StepList.tsx` + `StepDetails.tsx` (commit "steps"), chunk B `SubmittingView.tsx` (commit "sending"). Tests: run-views L279-297 (StepDetails half), new SubmittingView/StepDetails cases in `interactions.test.ts`. - Agent 2: chunk C `RunProgress.tsx` (commit "run progress", with the cancel question, `leaks` entry and cover case), chunk D `RunFailure.tsx` (commit "failure"). Tests: run-views L36-37, L74, L144-201, L299-354, L407-416 (its half of L279: the RunFailure fold), new cancel/failure cases. `StepList({ steps })` keeps its signature, so C and D use the old or the new StepList and the order does not matter. The only shared file is `lib/run-views.test.ts`; the two agents own disjoint hunks (list above), so the merge is mechanical. ## 10. What is wrong or missing in the card (cite) 1. Unit tests: the card lists L199, L200, L316, L317. Also coupled: L37, L74, L279-297, L413 (section 4a). The `hidden`-attribute test (L279) tests a Tailwind problem that no longer exists. 2. Gate: `-g ""` runs `a11y`, `aria`, `tab through` and two names.spec tests, but not keyboard.spec L86, names.spec L47/L61 (section 4b). The acceptance list needs them by name. 3. "Keep: the cancel question holds focus" lacks the D6 half: it is a page dialog, so it must close while signed out and reopen (design doc D6.3); `session-cover.spec.ts` and `leaks.spec.ts` are named by the plan (L37, Phase 6 card) but not in the bead's Scope. 4. Widget swap: `Stepper` "only if it can say waiting for you": it can (via `description`), but it fails the rule's real test (truncation, linear model); say "rejected" and skip the trial. 5. `app/globals.css` (risk 1) and the reduced-motion gate are not mentioned, though the plan's own exit requires `reduced-motion` to pass. 6. StepDetails is in this phase but appears in Phase 6 states (`result*`, 4 snapshots): the exit must run those and list the line that must stay. 7. The bead says the gate states are `sending`, `run-progress`, `run-started`, `failure`; `RunOpening`, `RunUnread` and the cancelled `RunFailure` have no state or no test at all (section 6, R6, F2). New cases are needed, and the Scope text ("selectors and class assertions only") forbids them. 8. Port numbers: phase 5 is 3451/8451 per the plan; `npm run test:prod` has no pair of its own yet ("once its config reads them"): run it last, alone. Efficiency notes: skip the Stepper trial; land chunk 0 once instead of four copies; run only the listed specs until the exit.

The checkout has no Phase 1 yet (`kit/ModuleShell.tsx` is absent, every file is still on `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`). Everything said about `ModuleShell` and `AppShell` below is taken from the plan, not read from code.

## 0. Decisions needed from the lead before coding (card errors, in order of damage)

1. **Who owns the result page's frame, and its `<main>`?** `RunResult.tsx:154` renders its own `<main id="innehall">`; `app/flows/[id]/page.tsx:681-684` renders `<FlowTopBar title=... />` as a sibling of `<RunResult>`. The plan (line 26) says a ported page renders no `<main>`, and Phase 3 turns `FlowTopBar` into the `ModuleShell` heading. No bead owns `app/flows/[id]/page.tsx` (Phase 3's Scope lists FlowTopBar, FlowRunPage, FlowPageStates and others, not page.tsx; Phase 6's Scope forbids it). Two mains or none breaks `page.getByRole("main")` (aria.spec.ts:26-28, names.spec.ts) in every result state. Proposal: Phase 6 starts after Phase 3 merges (add `.20` blocked by `.17`); Phase 3 owns the page.tsx edit (frame around `RunResult`, `FlowTopBar` sibling removed at page.tsx:682); `RunResult` then renders content only: no `<main>`, no top bar. Until then Phase 6 may keep a bare `<main id="innehall">` (no className) as the only legacy element.
2. **"Bespoke: none" cannot hold.** Five behaviours have no Astryx prop (checked: `Grid` has `columns: number | {minWidth,max,repeat}` only; `LayoutPanel`/`LayoutContent`/`Section`/`Card` have no sticky or max-height; `Dialog` height is `fit-content` with `maxHeight`): the 7fr/6fr two-column grid from 1024 px (RunResult.tsx:186), the sticky transcript column (:211), the transcript card capped at `100dvh - 3rem` with its text scrolling inside (RunTranscript.tsx:127), the docked pause bar `sticky bottom-0` with safe-area padding and `short:static` (RunResult.tsx:233), and the PDF iframe filling the dialog (ResultFiles.tsx:163,200). Ask: allow three CSS Modules using only Astryx tokens plus structural widths: `RunResult.module.css`, `RunTranscript.module.css`, `ResultFiles.module.css`. Fallback if refused: equal columns, no sticky column, a static pause bar, a fixed-height iframe; each is a regression the owner must accept (the pause bar is gate state `result-docked-player`).
3. **Button labels do not wrap.** `Button.tsx:86` sets `white-space: nowrap`; `Button.tsx:145-149` makes the label `overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis`. The old buttons wrap on purpose (RegenerateNotice.tsx:53, StepDetails.tsx:21, ResultFiles.tsx:51). At 320 px or 200 % zoom "Skapa dokumentet igen med rättningarna" and a file name as a button are cut with an ellipsis (the gate lists ellipsis apart, `checks.ts:216-217`, and only fails headings, `a11y.spec.ts:71`, so the gate stays green while words are lost). One theme correction in `kit/theme/eneo.theme.ts` (`button.base`: `whiteSpace: 'normal'`, `height: 'auto'`, `minHeight: var(--size-element-md)`) serves Phases 3, 5 and 6; decide once, who lands it.
4. **Scope is short of what the plan requires.** Add to Scope: `tests/e2e/leaks.spec.ts` (plan line 37 requires every new overlay there; today every overlay is opened on `/dev/foundation`, `leaks.spec.ts:78`, so a `go` per overlay must be added, once), `lib/run-views.test.ts` (it mounts RunResult, ResultFiles and RunTranscriptView and is not in the card's unit test list), `RunResult.module.css`, `RunTranscript.module.css`, `ResultFiles.module.css`. Also allow NEW unit tests for the edge cases in section 7 (the bead says "selectors and class assertions only").
5. **Card text that is wrong against the code:** (a) "result-document.test.ts (lines 34, 126, 235)": line 235 is the speaker-change dialog of `TranscriptPlayer` (Phase 7), not this phase; this phase's coupled lines are listed in section 4. (b) "Below a laptop's width the PDF opens in a new tab": true for the document's own row (`lg`, ResultFiles.tsx:130,149); the "Fler filer" rows switch at `sm` (640 px), ResultFiles.tsx:139,155. (c) Phase 8 line 719 removes `react-markdown` and `remark-gfm` "only if Phase 6 moved to Astryx Markdown", but `ReviewView.tsx:592` also renders `ReactMarkdown` and `ReviewView.tsx:26` imports `remarkResultHeadings` from `ResultDocument.tsx`: the condition is Phase 6 and Phase 7. (d) Gate state `result-steps-open` clicks `StepDetails` (Phase 5's file); its ARIA/behaviour is Phase 5's while this phase must keep it green. (e) `usePhaseHeading.ts:12-13` exports `PHASE_HEADING`, a Tailwind class string used by every phase's heading; no card lists it. RunResult stops using it; Phase 8 must delete it.
6. **Shared ARIA snapshots.** `result-390/1440`, `result-regenerate-390/1440`, `result-transcript-tab-390` also contain Phase 5's `button "Hur resultatet togs fram 2 steg"`, Phase 7's whole `TranscriptPlayer` subtree and Phase 3's `link "Alla flöden"`. Phase 6 updates only its own hunks; the lead regenerates once after merging 3, 5, 6, 7.

Shared between phases (name the other party):
| File | Other phase | What the other does |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/legacy-ui-files.json`, ARIA snapshots | all | mechanical merge; result snapshots see decision 6 |
| `lib/run-views.test.ts` | 5 | Phase 5: lines 199-200, 316-317. Phase 6: 99-119 (ResultFiles), 120-140 (RunResult), 370-455 (RunTranscriptView) |
| `lib/result-document.test.ts` | 7 | Phase 7: lines 234-236 (speaker dialog). Phase 6: the rest |

B depends on A only through `useCopy`/`CopyStatus`, whose signatures do not change.
- **C, frame and tabs:** `RunResult.tsx` (+ `RunResult.module.css`), the RunResult mounts in `lib/result-document.test.ts` (:134-242, :279-323, :393-462, :503-529) and `lib/run-views.test.ts:120-140`, the `result*` snapshots (own hunks), the keyboard and reading-position tests. title: Security: bump the backend's FastAPI stack past 14 advisories and audit Python in CI
description:
`pip-audit` on the backend's pins (`fastapi==0.115.0`, `python-multipart==0.0.12`; resolved Starlette 0.38.6) reports 14 advisories in two packages, none fixed by the current pins. Found 2026-10-01 while checking the port for security and performance. This is independent of the Astryx port and affects production on `main`.

Relevant to this module (uploads and the proxy):
- python-multipart 0.0.12: multipart parser denial of service through a large preamble/epilogue or unbounded part headers (CVE-2026-40347, CVE-2026-42561), excessive logging per byte (CVE-2024-53981), a negative `Content-Length` that loads the whole body into memory (CVE-2026-53540), urlencoded parser CPU cost and `;` separator mismatch (CVE-2026-53538/53539). Fixed in 0.0.31.
- Starlette 0.38.6: unbounded buffering of multipart parts without a filename (CVE-2024-47874, fixed 0.40.0); the event loop blocks while a large upload rolls over to disk (CVE-2025-54121, fixed 0.47.2); request URL reconstruction from an unvalidated Host or path (X41-2026-002, CVE-2026-54282); form limits ignored for urlencoded bodies (CVE-2026-54283, fixed 1.3.1).
FastAPI reads the request body before it runs a route's `Depends(...)` for a `File(...)` parameter, so the multipart cost can be reached before the session check.

Trial (copies and throwaway virtualenvs only): FastAPI 0.142.2, Starlette 1.7.0, uvicorn 0.54.0, httpx 0.28.1, itsdangerous 2.2.0, python-multipart 0.0.32, websockets 17.1. `pip-audit`: no known vulnerabilities. The backend's 117 tests pass on those versions, and pass on the old pins too (the logged tracebacks are expected test noise). The tests do not exercise real large uploads or the live relay against the new uvicorn and websockets.

## Read first
- `backend/requirements.txt`, `backend/requirements-runtime.txt`, `backend/Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the `backend` job), `README.md` section "Dependency security".

## Scope
Branch `fix/backend-deps` from `main`. Files: `backend/requirements.txt` (exact pins to the versions above), `backend/requirements-runtime.txt` if it needs a change, `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (one new step in the `backend` job), `README.md` (one sentence in "Dependency security").
The new CI step mirrors the frontend's existing "Audit production dependencies" step: install the pinned requirements, then `pip-audit` the installed set (`pip install pip-audit && pip-audit`), failing on any known vulnerability.

## Out of scope
- `backend/app/` code changes beyond what a new version forces (none were needed in the trial).
- Enabling Dependabot or any PR automation: `README.md` says that needs a separate decision.
- The frontend, the module kit repository (it has its own bead for the same finding).

## Steps to Reproduce
`uv venv --python 3.12 v && uv pip install --python v/bin/python -r backend/requirements.txt && uvx pip-audit --path v/lib/python3.12/site-packages` on `main`: 14 known vulnerabilities in python-multipart 0.0.12 and starlette 0.38.6.

## Steps
1. Reproduce: build a venv from the current pins and run `pip-audit` (14 findings).
2. Change the pins; build a fresh venv; `pip-audit` reports none.
3. `cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes (117).
4. Real-behaviour check, since the tests do not cover it: with the stub backend, upload a 200 MB file through `/api/eneo/flows/{id}/files` (the module's upload route) and record the process's peak memory before and after the bump; open the live relay WebSocket against the existing relay tests' fake Eneo and send one oversized frame (expect close 1009/1008 as in `test_live_relay.py`). 5. Add the CI step. Build the image: `docker build -t eneo-mod-speech-to-text:test .` and start it with `docker run` plus the health check from the README.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `pip-audit` on the pinned set reports no known vulnerabilities.
- The 117 backend tests pass; the image builds and answers `/health`.
- Peak memory for a 200 MB upload is no higher than before the bump (numbers in the PR).
- CI fails when a pinned package has a known vulnerability (show it once by temporarily pinning `python-multipart==0.0.12` on a scratch branch).

## Verify

```bash
cd backend && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt pip-audit && .venv/bin/pip-audit && .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests
```

title: Backend security: cap request bodies and never read a body before auth (same P0s as kit .22)
description:
Found by kit-perf in the module kit's BFF, which was carved from this backend. Two of the same problems are visible in this repo's source (read, not yet reproduced here):

- `backend/app/main.py` ~715: the allowlisted proxy does `body = await request.body()` with no size cap, then forwards `upstream.content`. In the kit the same shape peaked at ~2.07x the body in RSS (50 MB -> +105 MB; one authenticated 700 MB POST OOM-killed a 768 MB container).
- `backend/app/main.py` ~379, 408, 439: the upload routes take `upload_file: UploadFile = File(...)` and list `Depends(module_auth.require_session)` in the decorator. FastAPI parses the multipart body before dependencies run, so an unauthenticated 300 MB upload is spooled to /tmp and read before the 401.

## What to do
Mirror the kit's fix once kit bead kit-module-kit-ojs.22 has landed and passed its adversary review: stream the proxy body with a running cap (413), parse uploads after auth with Content-Length required and capped, and bound other bodies before auth. Reproduce each failure on THIS backend first (failing test), then fix. Do not design a second solution; reuse the kit's tested one.

## Acceptance
Failing-then-passing tests for the proxy cap, the pre-auth upload (401 with body unread) and the over-cap 413; measured RSS for a large authenticated and a large unauthenticated request; backend suite green.
